title-group.article-title: Dietary fiber and remission in Crohn disease.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Crohn disease is a chronic inflammatory bowel condition. Dietary factors are frequently discussed.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We enrolled 412 participants in a cohort study. Follow-up lasted two years.

sec.title: Statistical analysis
sec.p: We used deterministic regression models throughout.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Dietary fiber was associated with reduced disease activity during remission. No serious adverse events were observed.
